stage: STAGE 8 FORENSIC AUDIT OF BOTTLENECK DIAGNOSIS

ai_claims_audited.ai_claim: Ensemble spread has Spearman rho = +0.767 with forecast error.
ai_claims_audited.evidence_detail: Spearman rho = +0.7685 is with ABSOLUTE residual |y - pred| in Stage 6.1, NOT signed residual (rho = +0.0697). Stage 6.1 candidate model degraded EVEN CV MAE by +0.0457 W/m2 and failed all 4 performance gates.

ai_claims_audited.ai_claim: Ensemble spread is absent from current 37-feature champion.
ai_claims_audited.evidence_detail: Stage 8.1 uses MEPS deterministic control run features (cloud_frac, lwp_latest, iwp_latest, u700, v700), but zero ensemble spread features (meps_std_SW_IN, meps_std_total_cloud).

ai_claims_audited.ai_claim: Stage 8.12 uses a genuinely novel exploitation mechanism (regime/weighting) compared to Stage 6.1 flat GBDT input.
ai_claims_audited.evidence_detail: Mechanistically an architectural variation using the exact same underlying signal (meps_std_SW_IN). Association with absolute residual does not equal point-forecast MAE improvement.

ai_claims_audited.ai_claim: Stage 6.4 tested inter-run forecast revisions, not forward cloud trajectories within a single run.
ai_claims_audited.evidence_detail: Stage 6.4 tested D-1 18Z vs 12Z/06Z MEPS run differences. Passed MAE gate (-0.2657 W/m2) but failed fold-consistency (3/5 folds) and worst-fold degradation (+0.2857 W/m2).

ai_claims_audited.ai_claim: CAMS AOD550 was never taken to a forecasting experiment.
ai_claims_audited.evidence_detail: Stage 8.6B WAS EXECUTED and REJECTED! Feasibility passed (347/347 origins), but Stage 8.6B EVEN CV MAE degraded by +0.247252 W/m2 (37.867306 vs 37.620054 W/m2 control) and failed 4 of 6 decision gates.

Stage 8.7 tested MEPS DNI-anchored direct/diffuse two-head architecture. EVEN CV MAE degraded severely by +11.825787 W/m2 (49.445841 vs 37.620054 W/m2 control), 0/5 folds improved. Route CLOSED_REJECTED.

Stage 8.9A evaluated 6 independent cloud data sources (VIIRS, Meteosat, Ceilometer, All-Sky Imager, Cloud Motion Vectors). All failed feasibility due to dissemination latency (3-8h), polar night optical masking, extreme parallax shift (>20.9 km), or mountain ridge barriers. Route FAIL_CONFIRMED.

stage_8_12_recommendation.reasoning: Relying on meps_std_SW_IN uses a signal already tested and rejected in Stage 6.1. Architectural repackaging without pre-experiment risk-bounding proof does not satisfy POLARIS novelty requirements.

authoritative_bottleneck_conclusion.primary_limiting_factor: Irreducible NWP cloud-timing/phase errors inherent to 2.5 km regional NWP forecasts in Arctic complex terrain.
